title: The result Archimedes wanted on his tomb
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 300 186" role="img" aria-label="A sphere fitting exactly inside a cylinder" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><circle cx="150" cy="93" r="60" class="u" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M90,33 V153 M210,33 V153"/><path d="M90,33 A60,10 0 0 0 210,33"/><path d="M90,33 A60,10 0 0 1 210,33"/><path d="M90,153 A60,10 0 0 0 210,153"/><path d="M90,153 A60,10 0 0 1 210,153" stroke-dasharray="4 3" stroke-width="1"/><text x="150" y="97" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">sphere</text><text x="244" y="76" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">volume of</text><text x="244" y="90" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">sphere =</text><text x="244" y="104" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">⅔ of cylinder</text></svg>
back: A sphere fills exactly two-thirds of the cylinder that just encloses it. He is said to have asked for this figure on his tomb.

title: Cone: r, h and l
back: Radius, height and slant height form a right triangle: $l^2=r^2+h^2$. Curved surface uses $l$, volume uses $h$.

title: Cone on a hemisphere
back: The joined circles vanish. Surface = $\pi rl+2\pi r^2$; volume = cone + hemisphere.

title: Curved surface areas
back: Sphere: $4\pi r^2$. A solid hemisphere's total surface is $3\pi r^2$.

title: Volumes
back: Cone = one-third of its cylinder; hemisphere = half of a sphere.

title: Capsule
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 300 150" role="img" aria-label="A capsule: a cylinder with a hemisphere at each end" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M100,45 H200 M100,105 H200"/><path d="M100,45 A30,30 0 0 0 100,105" class="u" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M200,45 A30,30 0 0 1 200,105" class="u" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M100,45 V105 M200,45 V105" stroke-dasharray="4 3" stroke-width="1"/><text x="150" y="80" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">cylinder</text><text x="56" y="40" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">hemisphere</text><text x="244" y="40" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">hemisphere</text><path d="M70,128 H230" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M70,123 V133 M230,123 V133" stroke-width="1"/><text x="150" y="144" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">total length</text></svg>
back: Cylinder + two hemispheres. Surface = $2\pi rh+4\pi r^2$; cylinder length = total length − 2r.

title: Tent
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 300 186" role="img" aria-label="A tent: a cone on top of a cylinder of the same radius" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M150,18 L92,96 M150,18 L208,96" class="u" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M92,96 A58,11 0 0 0 208,96"/><path d="M92,96 A58,11 0 0 1 208,96" stroke-dasharray="4 3" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M92,96 V158 M208,96 V158"/><path d="M92,158 A58,11 0 0 0 208,158"/><path d="M92,158 A58,11 0 0 1 208,158" stroke-dasharray="4 3" stroke-width="1"/><text x="222" y="56" font-size="11" text-anchor="start" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">cone: πrl</text><text x="222" y="130" font-size="11" text-anchor="start" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">cylinder: 2πrh</text></svg>
back: Canvas = curved surface of the cone + curved surface of the cylinder. No floor.

title: Cube with a hemisphere
back: On top or scooped out, the surface is $6a^2+\pi r^2$: one circle lost, one curved surface gained.

title: Surface or volume?
back: Joined faces vanish from the surface, but volumes always add.

title: Units of capacity
back: Convert at the end of the working, not in the middle.
